newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria December forex reserves fall to $518 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria December forex reserves fall to $518 mln.

text.p: Bulgaria's central bank foreign exchange reserves fell to $518.425 million in December from $525.1 million a month earlier, the Bulgarian National Bank said on Wednesday.
BNB FX RESERVES, DEC NOV DEC'95
"The fall by some $7 million last month was mainly due to payments on Bulgaria's foreign debt," a central bank official told Reuters. He declined to elaborate.
Bulgaria has to meet some $300 million payments of its foreign debt in the first quarter, including $135.5 million Brady bond coupon payments due on January 28.

Finance Minister Dimitar Kostov said on Tuesday that Bulgaria will make the coupon payment through its State Fund for Reconstruction and Development, which collects external loans. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
